lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast vertical lines visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, approximately twice the width of the lines themselves, with slight convergence towards the ventral side.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 9th and 10th lines (posterior) are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the lower torso mass. The 9th line is fragmented into two distinct segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 5 distinct white spots located on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb, with higher density in the mid-haunch region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-posterior haunch exhibit horizontal alignment, forming a short geometric axis.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white horizontal band visible on the mid-segment of the anterior right limb (carpal region).
